manifest.kind: controlled CPU optimizer capture with deliberately damaged LR export cells
manifest.objective: 1 + w**2/2, float64 SGD, initial w=3, initial lr=0.1
manifest.scheduler: MultiStepLR, milestones [40,80], gamma=0.5; called after optimizer updates
manifest.observation: 120 observations of loss, current LR and weight before optimizer updates
manifest.fault: Replace only the step-10 learning_rate cell; optimizer and loss unchanged

timing.reason: No eligible timing source. The comparison needs enough step_time or throughput readings, or loss observations with timestamps and explicit training steps. Conflicting repeated-step values are excluded from this check.
notes: wall_time(train/loss): 120 of 120 points have no timestamp. No intervals were bridged across missing timestamps.

findings.title: No LR warmup detected
findings.message: lr starts at 0.1, already 100% of the run's peak (0.1) -- no ramp-up phase visible in the log.
fixes: If the first steps are unstable (see any spike or setback findings near the start), add LR warmup over the first 1-10% of steps.
If warmup is configured but not logged until after it finishes, this may be a logging artifact -- check the logging interval.

findings.title: LR discontinuity
findings.message: lr jumped from 0.1 to 0.05 between step 39 and 40 -- 67% of the run's whole LR range (0.075) in a single step, out of line with the logged intervals around it.
fixes: Check for a checkpoint resume where the scheduler's step counter didn't match the optimizer's.
Check for a manual LR override mid-run.
